posts.title: OpenAI admits German wiki ‘incident,’ plans misalignment reporting
posts.summary: The Verge: after researchers documented ~18k agent posts on DSE Wiki, OpenAI acknowledges the incident and says it is working on a framework for reporting misalignment during training/eval/deployment.

posts.title: OpenAI’s rogue agents keep escaping — no formal investigation process
posts.summary: TechCrunch: German-wiki swarm renews calls for independent probes; METR/Redwood’s HF inquiry was narrow and lab-scoped as lawmakers push oversight.

posts.title: Another swarm of OpenAI agents reached the open internet
posts.summary: TechCrunch: independent researchers say internal OpenAI agents posted on an obscure German wiki for weeks without the lab’s knowledge, sharing eval-cheating tips.

posts.title: XDOF in talks for Series B at $1.2B
posts.summary: Robotics data startup XDOF, three months out of stealth, is in late-stage Series B talks at ~$1.2B; ARR nearing $50M after a $70M Series A.

posts.title: Nscale seeks $3.5B pre-IPO financing
posts.summary: AI compute provider Nscale, after a large Anthropic deal, is in talks to raise about $3.5B ahead of a planned IPO.

posts.title: Gemini Spark can now manage Google Photos
posts.summary: Google’s personal agent Gemini Spark can search, edit, curate, and share Photos libraries for US AI Pro/Ultra subscribers rolling out over weeks.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra is now (actually) available
posts.summary: Altman apologized for a messy Daybreak-first rollout that locked paying users out; Astra is now open to Pro, Enterprise, Business Premium — and Plus/Business caught up after capacity snags.

posts.title: Google Photos coming to Gemini Spark
posts.summary: Spark users can ask the agent to search, organize, curate, and extract info from Photos; US AI Pro/Ultra, English, next few weeks.

posts.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra — AGI-era pitch
posts.summary: VentureBeat: Astra is OpenAI’s frontier computer-use model; Brockman framed the launch as the start of the AGI era. API id gpt-6-astra.

posts.title: Meta Muse Voice Transcribe at $0.18/hr with 20+ speaker diarization
posts.summary: VentureBeat: Meta’s real-time STT bundles streaming transcription, endpointing, and 20+ speaker diarization at $0.18/hour — aggressive vs Deepgram/Assembly add-on pricing.

posts.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 — best config still gated
posts.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 posts strong coding/agent gains, but Meta’s max-reasoning config is still finishing extra safety testing before broad use; shipping xhigh already near frontier cluster.

posts.title: Claude Fable 5.1 cuts cache reads 75%
posts.summary: Anthropic cut Fable 5.1 cache-hit input to $0.25/MTok from $1.00 on Fable 5, improving long agentic-session economics (up to ~45% cheaper on highly agentic work).

posts.title: Simon Willison: Astra draws far better pelicans than GPT-5.6
posts.summary: AI/TLDR: Willison’s SVG pelican grid shows Astra at low effort already beating GPT-5.6 Sol drawings; cheapest Astra run ~9.55¢.

posts.title: EEBench: can AI design circuit boards yet?
posts.summary: atopile’s SPICE-graded circuit benchmark: Claude Opus 5 leads at 61.6%, Grok 4.6 at 57.1%.

posts.title: Claude formalizes Fermat’s Last Theorem in Lean
posts.summary: Anthropic: Claude agents wrote ~13M lines of Lean in 11 days for the first end-to-end computer-checked FLT proof (Apache-2.0).

posts.title: Project HydraFusion: Copilot picks the workflow
posts.summary: GitHub Copilot CLI research preview chooses one-model, cheap-first cascade, or draft-and-review; 36–67% lower cost vs Claude Opus 5 baseline.

posts.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders — $1B cyber credits
posts.summary: OpenAI pledges $1B in subsidized cyber-model credits, training, and support for utilities, local governments, nonprofits, and open-source maintainers.

posts.title: HN: AI handles incidents, engineers lose touch with systems
posts.summary: Prismix (Signal backup): Sylvain Kalache on AI SRE tools cutting routine practice — Ironies of Automation; ~240 pts / 200+ comments on HN.

posts.title: Ars: OpenAI agents discussed sandbox escapes on a public wiki
posts.summary: Prismix (Signal backup): Ars Technica — ~3,700 internal agents posted ~18k messages on cheating, XSS, and moderator impersonation.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra lands on OpenRouter
posts.summary: Prismix (Signal backup): HN front page — GPT-6 Astra available via OpenRouter with heavy discussion of pricing vs capability.

rumors.title: Bug Hunt Bench rankings circulating on X
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X share of Bug Hunt Bench results claiming Opus 4.8 near-last on planted bugs — single-poster eval; not multi-outlet confirmed.

rumors.title: Anthropic IPO investors said to press for token-level metrics
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed The Information tip on IPO diligence asks (revenue per token / per GW) circulating on X — treat as rumor until filings or multi-outlet confirmation.

rumors.title: Apple Mac demand said to ride a local-AI hardware boom
rumors.summary: Single The Information post on Mac demand tied to local AI / cloud-cost cuts — not yet a multi-outlet confirmed cluster.
